rationale: SWIFTD17 (OO family closure #613 family sweep): bare capitalized calls are constructions (instantiates ONLY) regardless of name length — the inherited `length > 1` carve-out mislabeled single-letter constructions (`struct E: Error` / `E()`, 15 sites in swift-nio corpus tests) as calls on BOTH sides (F5-blind shared defect). Single capital letters are reserved for types in Swift naming rules, never free functions, so length carries no disambiguating information.
